answer: A sybil farm must fund every fake identity with real locked value, so marginal attack cost scales linearly while honest agents earn yield. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent locks collateral before voting on peers, and votes are weighted by staked reputation rather than raw identity count. Like a sonnet's strict meter forcing careful word choice, the stake requirement forces attackers to pay per identity.
